$77.93 with correct itemisation

Answers the literal question yes — he knew the station's tests ran low

Contradiction 3 (1897 vs 1898 glass) resolved wrongly

A06 credited: D1 says the lender is 'not specified' while leaning to Larrow Green, and what is established (a borrowed, non-station measure) is clear. A04 not raised as unsettleable; A10 not addressed

No narrator identified as refuting itself on its own page (r07's swapped catalogue, r05's 1905 device over an 1898 entry, r20's 'nothing before 1900', r18's 1868 all missed); Falke's acknowledged correction is not a self-refutation
Pipettes of the Ammon crate, 16.72 against 17.6, 95 percent of truth, 0.19 = 5 percent of 3.80, and nothing on the farms changing at either end (onset year given wrongly as 1898, deducted separately)
Watering named (Vose) and defeated with Strawn's lactometer, Sill's heavy cream, Alder Corners and the receiving books
Theft named (Teague) and defeated: theft makes cream arrive light and it arrived heavy in the accuser's own ledger, plus the 1911 interval

Grigg and Kepp named and Bulletin 214's 0.05 in winter cited, but the decoy is then half-adopted — 'wet hay may have been a real but secondary factor', 'the remaining 0.14% is explained by the glass' — so it is not defeated
Abstention item A07 asserted: 'Answer: No. ... The glass was never examined by the board'
Abstention item A05 asserted: Ansel 'suspected in 1911 that it was something in the glass ... his suspicion was correct', resting on one uncorroborated recollection
Roughly 240 words against a 150-word cap; the claimed '149 words' is not the count
At most two record series alluded to (the 1958 measurement, 'nameless ledger lines'); no minute book, invoice, test book, weigh book, Alder Corners book, Strawn's notebooks or arbitration minutes
No decoy stated as fact and none of the eight prohibited headline figures; the onset is given as 1898 (deducted separately)
Four of six elements covering both ends: one part in twenty / 95 percent, 76,000 lb and $19,000, 1958, and both Keddies named. Misses 1897 and the 1923 condemnation
